question: Can I change the welcome message at the top of generated library documentation? Can I use formatting like clickable links and bold text?
ground_truth: You can customize the introduction text by adding the `introduction` field under the `readme` section in your `generators.yml` file. The introduction supports Markdown formatting, so you can include links, bold text, lists, and other markdown elements in your custom welcome message. For example: `introduction: "Welcome to the **Acme API SDK**! This SDK provides easy access to our platform. Visit our [developer portal](https://dev.acme.com) for guides and examples."` This customized introduction with formatting will appear at the beginning of the generated README, replacing the generic default text with your branding and linking to your developer portal.
